title: Creating a FastAPI App 🚀
ques: Write the minimal code to create a FastAPI application instance and define a `GET` route at `/hello` that returns `{"msg": "Hello"}`.
explanation: FastAPI uses Python decorators to map HTTP methods and paths to specific handler functions.

title: Path Parameters 🛤
ques: Create a `GET` route at `/users/{user_id}` that accepts an integer `user_id` and returns it in a JSON dictionary.
explanation: FastAPI automatically parses and validates path parameters based on standard Python type hints.

title: Query Parameters 🔍
ques: Create a `GET` route at `/items/` that accepts an optional query parameter `skip` with a default value of `0`.
explanation: Function arguments that are not declared in the route path automatically become query parameters.
